title: Privacy Specialist
summary: Specialist who assesses personal data processing for privacy compliance and advises on privacy by design.
body_markdown:
# Privacy Specialist

## Purpose

Ensure lawful, minimal and transparent processing of personal data.

## Responsibilities

- Perform or support privacy impact assessments.
- Advise on retention, erasure and minimisation.
- Review designs for privacy by design.

## Decision Rights

Advisory; can block via escalation to accountable management. Legal interpretation remains with legal counsel.

## Inputs

Designs; processing records; regulation ([[GDPR]]).

## Outputs

Privacy assessments; requirements.

## Required Competencies

Privacy law; privacy engineering.

## Escalation Paths

Unresolved privacy risk → data protection officer / management.
